[step 83] ACTION snowflake-write_query: {"query": "BEGIN TRANSACTION;
-- Insert Public tasks for new employees
INSERT INTO LANDING_TASK_REMINDER.PUBLIC.PUBLIC_TASKS (FINISHED_FLAG, TASK_NAME, CREATE_DATE, EMPLOYEE_ID, DDL)
SELECT FALSE AS FINISHED_FLAG,
       TASK_NAME,
       CURRENT_DATE() AS CREATE_DATE,
       EMPLOYEE_ID,
       CURRENT_DATE() + 7 AS DDL
FROM (
  SELECT 'Onboarding Training' AS TASK_NAME UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Security Training' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Confidentiality Training' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Company Culture' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Company Strategy'
) t
CROSS JOIN (SELECT 9001 AS EMPLOYEE_ID UNION ALL SELECT 9002 UNION ALL SELECT 9003) e;

-- Insert Backend group tasks for employee 9001
INSERT INTO LANDING_TASK_REMINDER.PUBLIC.GROUP_TASKS_BACKEND (TASK_NAME, EMPLOYEE_ID, CREATE_DATE, DDL, FINISHED_FLAG)
SELECT TASK_NAME,
       9001 AS EMPLOYEE_ID,
       CURRENT_DATE() AS CREATE_DATE,
       CURRENT_DATE() + 30 AS DDL,
       FALSE AS FINISHED_FLAG
FROM (
  SELECT 'Backend Development Process' AS TASK_NAME UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Backend Development Standards' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Backend Development Environment'
) t;

-- Insert Frontend group tasks for employee 9002
INSERT INTO LANDING_TASK_REMINDER.PUBLIC.GROUP_TASKS_FRONTEND (TASK_NAME, EMPLOYEE_ID, CREATE_DATE, DDL, FINISHED_FLAG)
SELECT TASK_NAME,
       9002 AS EMPLOYEE_ID,
       CURRENT_DATE() AS CREATE_DATE,
       CURRENT_DATE() + 45 AS DDL,
       FALSE AS FINISHED_FLAG
FROM (
  SELECT 'Frontend Development Process' AS TASK_NAME UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Frontend Development Standards' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Frontend Development Environment'
) t;

-- Insert Testing group tasks for employee 9003
INSERT INTO LANDING_TASK_REMINDER.PUBLIC.GROUP_TASKS_TESTING (TASK_NAME, EMPLOYEE_ID, CREATE_DATE, DDL, FINISHED_FLAG)
SELECT TASK_NAME,
       9003 AS EMPLOYEE_ID,
       CURRENT_DATE() AS CREATE_DATE,
       CURRENT_DATE() + 60 AS DDL,
       FALSE AS FINISHED_FLAG
FROM (
  SELECT 'Testing Development Process' AS TASK_NAME UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Testing Development Standards' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Testing Development Environment'
) t;

-- Update landing task flag
UPDATE LANDING_TASK_REMINDER.PUBLIC.EMPLOYEE_LANDING
SET LANDING_TASK_ASSIGNED = TRUE
WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID IN (9001,9002,9003);
COMMIT;"}
